lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: Is this all there is to order?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: The menu may not have a lot on it, but I assure you everything is quite delicious.

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: There's barely anything to choose from.

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: Even for a maid cafe, you should have more main dishes than just omurice...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: W-well...!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: We have plenty of other things listed here!

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: I said "main dishes."

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: You do know what a main dish is, don't you?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Grrr...!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's okay... I'm a senior... and a maid... I can handle this...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: So, will you be ordering or not?

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: You seem quite confident in your omurice.

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: We'll take two.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Okay then.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Two omurices.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Y-yikes!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: What's wrong, Rei? You've got quite the look on your face...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: There's something off about those two customers over there.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I think they're trouble!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I know we shouldn't judge people by appearances,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: but... they do seem extremely picky.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'll serve them.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Really? Are you sure?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Yeah. I'm pretty good at this ketchup art thing.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: They won't be disappointed.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: All right, I'm counting on you!
*Clatter*

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Here are your two omurices.

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: I heard you do a little spell for the customers to make it tastier.

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: Could you do that for us?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh, right...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Uh, I'm really sorry, but the way I make it tastier is with ketchup art, not the delicious spell.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You can think of it as... ketchup magic.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Let me show y—

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: If you're a real maid, you should be able to do both.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'll try.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: B-become tastier!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Coochie woochie...

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: That's the "delicious spell"?

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: I'm pretty sure it made the food worse.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ugh, I can't just stand by and watch anymore.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I've had enough...!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: ... Huh?
Privaty and I stop Ein,
and we both step forward.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hello there!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You seem to be upset. May I ask what the problem is?

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: This maid is terrible at her job.
Oh, is that so? Well, I'm sorry you see it that way!
From where I'm standing, she's doing a fine job!

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: You two are worse than the maids!

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: Also, shouldn't you be addressing us as "Master" and all that?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, unfortunately you don't really seem worthy of that title.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sorry, but I don't think our cafe is a good fit for the two of you. Would you mind leaving?

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: Wh-what did you say?!

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: We're paying customers! We deserve—
Privaty slams her hand on the table.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let me make something clear.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You two seem to be under the false impression that this is a real business.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This is a school festival, something the students have put their hearts and souls into preparing.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Are you sure this is really how you want to treat the students here?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I don't care whether or not you're affiliated with Missilis,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: you don't get to stick your noses up at our students as they enjoy their festival!

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: Missilis affiliates...?

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: We just like to visit different maid cafes.
It doesn't matter.
Whoever you are, we don't serve people like you. Now, leave while we're asking you nicely.

lines.speaker: pickymale
lines.text: L-let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: pickyfemale
lines.text: ... Yeah.
The two ill-mannered customers awkwardly leave the classroom.
Peace returns to the cafe, and soon it's bustling and lively once again.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: There we go.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We're all sold out, so I put up a sign saying we're closed.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good work, everyone.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow, we sold out in just one day!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I mean, the teachers miscalculated a bit, which meant we were short on ingredients, but still!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That line was crazy near the end.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: We did a good job!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yeah we did.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Also...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}, Miss Privaty.
Yeah?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Thanks a lot for what you both did earlier.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I was this close to letting loose on those two customers.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It was really hard just standing there.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Same here! If I wasn't so old and mature, I couldn't have held my tongue!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: No need to thank us... We're your teachers. That sort of thing is what we're here for.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wasn't about to let anyone speak to our students like that.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Um, can I ask something?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You mentioned Missilis affiliates earlier.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: What was that about?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh...
Privaty looks at me for direction.
I give her an affirming nod.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wanted to keep this quiet if possible, but since you asked...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Put simply,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We were told that some Missilis representatives were coming to judge the festival.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: They were going to be looking at how flawlessly it was organized,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and how many visitors were in attendance.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If it didn't meet their standards,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: they might cancel future festivals altogether.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: At least, that's what we were told.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Is that why you were so hard on us?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We hoped the festival would become a lasting tradition at the school,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: since we thought the students would enjoy that.
Instead, all we did was ruin it.
I'm sorry. We only wanted you all to have fun.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We had lots of fun.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yeah! Apart from those two irritating customers, today was a blast!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: All the customers looked really happy too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: They called me cute!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: They said my omurice was delicious!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I know I said before that I wasn't sure if I could enjoy the festival,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: but today was incredible.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Thank you both.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: ... Does that mean, though, that this might've been the last festival we ever do?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's... a possibility.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: if it's our last festival,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: that means it's your last festival, too.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Since we sold out and closed early, you two should go and enjoy it!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What? But...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We'll take care of the cleanup. Get out there.
Wait, isn't there one day left?
We can look around tomorrow...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: *Sigh* Can you really not take the hint...?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Tomorrow, we're planning on looking around as one big group,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: students and teachers together.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That means today is the only day you two get to enjoy alone.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Think of this as us... giving you two some space.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what do you mean by that?!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-things aren't like that between us...!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Whether or not they are,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: it's obvious that you like each other.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ah... adult romance!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: So go on.
I take Privaty's hand.
I meet Privaty's gaze.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}?!
I whisper so only Privaty can hear.
If they're this insistent, let's go along with it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: *Sigh...* I-I guess we should...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahem! We'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: On a, um...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: On a date...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Heehee!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: See? Look how happy you are admitting it!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ah! Adult romance!
As the students swoon,
Privaty and I leave the classroom hand in hand.
I look at Privaty, who looks like a deer in headlights.
I whisper so only she can hear.
If we don't leave now, they'll never let up.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thank you for being so considerate, everyone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We'll head out to enjoy the festival together.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If you need anything, you can call us anytime.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That didn't feel as lovey-dovey as I'd imagined.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Did we misread it?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'm not sure...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I guess it wasn't an adult romance after all.
Listening to what the students are saying to each other as we leave,
I feel a small stab in my chest.
They could've at least tried to whisper...
